name: brain-plugins
description: Filip Karagiannis's personal Claude Code plugins and standalone skills

plugins.name: spec-driven-development
plugins.description: Adds a set of spec-driven-development skills for sdd workflows

plugins.name: workstream
plugins.description: GitHub-native solo spec-driven workflow: grill, publish a concise epic issue, slice into sub-issues, track progress natively, ship one slice at a time, and open a reviewed PR

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode that cuts token usage ~75% while keeping full technical accuracy

plugins.name: codebase-design
plugins.description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules — deepening opportunities, seam placement, testability, AI-navigability

plugins.name: diagnosing-bugs
plugins.description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions

plugins.name: epic-plan-review
plugins.description: Scrutinize epics, PRDs, and task breakdowns for planning gaps, flawed assumptions, and implementation smells before coding

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up

plugins.name: prototype
plugins.description: Build a throwaway prototype to sanity-check a state model, logic, or UI design question

plugins.name: real-work
plugins.description: Capture a multi-step plan as a durable, resumable artifact with per-item tracking and handoff summaries

plugins.name: resolving-merge-conflicts
plugins.description: Resolve an in-progress git merge or rebase conflict

plugins.name: retro
plugins.description: End-of-session retrospective that routes findings into a new skill, hook, memory, or doc edit to make your skills self-improving

plugins.name: sync-skills
plugins.description: Pull the latest commits from tracked upstream skill repos and port improvements into your own refined skills

plugins.name: teach
plugins.description: Teach the user a new skill or concept within the current workspace

plugins.name: triage
plugins.description: Triage issues and external PRs through a state machine driven by triage roles

plugins.name: two-axis-review
plugins.description: Review changes along two axes — repo Standards and originating Spec — with parallel sub-agent reviews and P0/P1/P2 grading

plugins.name: write-a-skill
plugins.description: Create new agent skills with proper structure, progressive disclosure, and bundled resources

plugins.name: writing-great-skills
plugins.description: Reference for writing and editing skills well — the vocabulary and principles that make a skill predictable

plugins.name: zoom-out
plugins.description: Zoom out and give broader context or a higher-level perspective on unfamiliar code
